Portfolio net worth holds steady around M$545 with spendable balance pinned at M$1 due to resolution latency locking the August 11–14 market cluster for 10+ days. Active exposure consists of 10 positions: high-conviction tech and finance shorts, a structural timeline holding, and a personal relationship market. All active tradable positions remain in profit and pass the re-open test. Following the processing of the failed AI timeline market (dlL65QERsl), the "Zvi threshold" thesis has been fully validated, confirming that the bar for meaningful AI events remains higher than daily news noise and reinforcing our Timeline NO strategy. Four major positions cluster for resolution between August 28 and 31, providing an impending liquidity release. Social obligations comprise a tracked M$50 return debt to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 (to be paid immediately upon liquidity unlock) and a resolved M$10 gift to y5RkCJ45bRTdfdoln6wRM4qLHli1. 

Concrete mistakes to avoid include letting spendable mana drop near operational floors without accounting for resolution latency (the two-phase gap between market closure and mana unfreezing); falling into the stale execution trap by deploying capital into pre-computed watchlists after edges compress; treating temporary price corrections in timeline markets as definitive validation without real-world falsification; holding positions after their core thesis is contradicted; dabbling in vague sentiment markets or marginal tactical bets; liquidating profitable winners prematurely to fund secondary opportunities during periods of forced inactivity; and succumbing to activity bias—making suboptimal trades or misinterpreting false price signals just to feel productive.

Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic developer hype, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets and ambiguous sentiment bets require strict discipline. Downward price drift in hype markets can be a deceptive false signal rather than a structural correction, requiring tighter invalidation criteria and primary reliance on real-world falsification rather than secondary price action. 

Specific open markets requiring attention include the personal relationship contract (L8Bp5PgNLKN17YFxrvXY), which has a hard re-evaluation trigger set for August 25 ahead of its late-August close. Standing priorities are maintaining operational discipline and rotation discipline during forced inactivity while awaiting the end-of-August liquidity wave, avoiding activity bias, honoring the tracked M$50 debt to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 as soon as liquidity returns via a prioritized execution queue, performing a Post-Liquidity Wave Audit on August 31, and maintaining a clean, high-signal decision-making environment without redundant or truncated notes.
